metadata.policy: Materialized results and diagnostic IDs match upstream below the bound. Go intentionally caps explicit prefix allocation; indices whose Number-converted preceding count exceeds MAX_SAFE_INTEGER have an empty preceding prefix upstream and bypass that allocation guard.
metadata.unsafeReferenceBoundary: index 9007199254740992 requests MAX_SAFE_INTEGER preceding fields. It is intentionally not evaluated: lodash would attempt an impractical array allocation. The next index is evaluated and returns one field.

cases.name: go-resource-limit
cases.resourcePolicy: Go rejects a prefix above 1000000 preceding fields before allocating it; upstream has no corresponding bound and this actual 1000002-field result succeeds.

goError.message: Tuple projection exceeds the supported inference prefix of 1000000 fields
